officialLinks.label: Harvard College grading, GPA, repeats, cross-registration

helpIntro: Harvard College uses a 4.0 FAS scale with A=4.00, A-=3.67, B+=3.33 through D-=0.67, while E and other failing marks count as zero. Use Harvard credits to estimate current, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: For Harvard College undergraduates only. Harvard has no A+ grade. Passing Pass/Fail/SAT grades and passing external work are excluded; failed courses count. Repeat treatment depends on whether the original course was passed, so the replacement-only Repeat Impact tool is disabled.
helpExample: A 4-credit A earns 16.00 grade points and a 4-credit B+ earns 13.32. Together, 29.32 ÷ 8 = 3.665.

gradeExplanations.E: E is failing and counts as 0.00 in GPA.
gradeExplanations.ABS: Absent is a failing grade and counts as 0.00.
gradeExplanations.NCR: No Credit is failing and counts as 0.00.
gradeExplanations.FL: Fail in a Pass/Fail course counts as 0.00.
gradeExplanations.EXL: Excluded is treated as failing and counts as 0.00.
gradeExplanations.EXT: Extension is temporary; use the final grade when posted.
gradeExplanations.WD: Approved withdrawal carries no course credit and is not part of the College GPA formula.

specialTypes.name: Harvard FAS course
specialTypes.note: Use the final FAS grade and Harvard credits. There is no A+ grade.

specialTypes.name: Harvard Summer School course for College credit
specialTypes.note: Harvard College includes Summer School courses taken for credit in its GPA.

specialTypes.name: Transfer / out-of-residence course
specialTypes.note: Passing external/out-of-residence grades do not enter the Harvard College GPA.

specialTypes.name: Repeated course after a passing first attempt
specialTypes.note: The second iteration of a course already passed shows zero credit and does not count in GPA.

specialTypes.name: Cross-registered course
specialTypes.note: Passing cross-registration is normally excluded from College GPA, while failing grades count. Confirm the posted Harvard treatment before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: Do not use a replacement estimate. For a failed-course repeat, enter both counted attempts as completed courses. For a repeat after a passing grade, mark the second attempt as the excluded repeat course type.
